description: Genuine locally verified Galileo E1-B SBF recording (188/188 ADKD=0 tags verified via GSC Merkle Root + ECDSA P-256 + TESLA SHA-256 + HMAC-SHA-256).

attributes.authenticated_scope: Galileo E1-B I/NAV ADKD=0 navigation data (Word Types 1-5: ephemeris, clock corrections, ionospheric/BGD, health/DVS)

provenance.original_source: Galileo E1-B Signal-in-Space (E07, E18, E21, E27) recorded via Septentrio mosaic-X5
provenance.publishing_organisation: European GNSS Service Centre (GSC cryptographic material) & Algafix/OSNMA KU Leuven (recorded SBF)
provenance.measurement_method: Local Galileo OSNMA SIS ICD v1.1 verification (Merkle SHA-256 + ECDSA P-256 DSM-KROOT + TESLA SHA-256 + HMAC-SHA-256 ADKD=0)

evidence.licence: EUPL-1.2 (recorded SBF from Algafix/OSNMA, KU Leuven) & European GNSS Service Centre (GSC) public OSNMA cryptographic material (© European Union)
limitations: Galileo OSNMA cryptographically authenticates broadcast I/NAV navigation message data bits (ADKD=0: ephemeris, clock, ionospheric/BGD, health/DVS) ONLY — it does NOT authenticate user position accuracy, pseudorange measurements, receiver integrity, or protect against replay/meaconing spoofing.
Recorded receiver data verification does not perform live Galileo System Time (GST) loose time synchronisation checks required for real-time TESLA security against delayed replay.
Broadcast NMA Header status is NMAS=1 ('test', Galileo OSNMA public test phase, August 2023), not operational service (NMAS=2).
75 complete subframes in the recording had NMA_Header=0x00 (OSNMA not broadcast on that satellite/subframe).
Recording publication/availability timestamp (available_at) is not embedded in the SBF file and remains unknown (null).

claim.source_label: Synthetic claim against genuine recorded Galileo E1-B SBF
